headline: Preventive services panel meets, votes in private
pages: The US Preventive Services Task Force held its first meeting since March 2025. The 16-member panel, largely remade by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., voted on recommendations for cervical cancer screening, perinatal depression and unhealthy alcohol use. Those recommendations had waited more than a year after meetings were canceled. The discussion was livestreamed for the first time, but the votes were private. Members debated a Trump administration policy requiring removal of diversity, equity and inclusion language, after the agency cut subpopulation data from the recommendations.
Member Alicia Fernandez warned that edits from political leadership could erode the perception of scientific independence. Source: STAT News.
